description: A test script for Git command behaviors, including setup, command execution, and error handling, focusing on 'tag', 'branch', and 'for-each-ref' commands with various options and argument validity checks.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting success, runs commands, and checks output.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Runs commands expected to fail and verifies error output.

methods.name: test_line_count
methods.description: Checks the number of lines in a file.

methods.name: test_grep
methods.description: Searches for a pattern in a file.

methods.name: test_commit
methods.description: Creates a commit with a specified message.
